query: "Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America" steel aluminum tariff exposure

statements.text: The steelmaker also plans to deliver its steel sheets from the US mill to Hyundai Motor Group’s EV-dedicated assembly lines, dubbed Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America LLC (HMGMA), in Georgia, which is capable of producing 300,000 units annually

It also vowed to invest nearly $6 billion to build its steel-making unit Hyundai Steel Co.'s first US steel mill in Louisiana, which will be an electric arc furnace mill with an annual steel production capacity of 2.7 million tons

Once it completes the construction of its first-ever US steel mill in Louisiana in the first quarter of 2029, it will provide its steel products to Hyundai Motor’s Alabama-based plant with an annual capacity of 330,000 units and Kia’s plant in the US state of Georgia with a capacity of 350,000 units.
Last month, Trump ordered a 25% import tax on all steel and aluminium entering the US.
Its steel-making firm Hyundai Steel is also about to take a hit from 25% US tariffs reimposed on all foreign steel and aluminum products.
